name: ST NUCLEO-G431KB (Nucleo-32)
description: Breadboard-friendly Arduino-Nano-format Nucleo with a 170 MHz Cortex-M4F (CORDIC/FMAC, op-amps, comparators, FDCAN) and a built-in ST-LINK/V2-1.
notes: Nano pin layout (2x15, 15.24 mm row spacing) but signals differ from an Arduino Nano; IO is 3.3 V only. One user LED (LD3) and a reset button; no user button.
UFQFPN32 MCU: only 22 I/Os reach the headers (D0-D13, A0-A7). PA11/PA12 are shared between USB D-/D+ and FDCAN (D10/D2); there is no USB connector or CAN transceiver on the board.
Header pin order follows ST's Nucleo-32 pinout (CN3 = D1..D12, CN4 = D13..VIN); physical orientation was derived from the Arduino Nano layout, not measured on a board.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
